_comment: Psychiatric-pipeline endpoint. Follows the exact registry shape established for herg_inhibition_v1.json / cyp3a4_inhibition_v1.json -- registering this makes CYP2D6 loadable through the SAME generic drugsim_predict.model_registry/pipeline.run_inference machinery those two already use, no new serving-path code required. NOT YET wired into the live deployment (deployment/docker/Dockerfile.predict-api and render.yaml still list only hERG/CYP3A4's GitHub Release assets) -- that is a separate, deliberate deploy step, not done in this pass.

final_report_status_history.note: Registered offline for local/offline multi-objective screening use. Not promoted to VALIDATED FOR INTERNAL RESEARCH -- no external validation performed yet, and this endpoint has not been through the same multi-report review CYP3A4 received before its own promotion.

endpoint.name: CYP2D6 inhibition
endpoint.definition: label=1 (inhibitor) if aggregated IC50 <= 10000 nM (10 uM), else label=0 (non-inhibitor)
endpoint.threshold_note: 10 uM is a literature convention for a binary CYP-inhibition-risk call, not a universal biological constant -- same convention class already used for hERG/CYP3A4.
endpoint.target: ChEMBL CHEMBL289, Cytochrome P450 2D6, Homo sapiens, SINGLE PROTEIN, UniProt P10635
endpoint.scientific_caveat: This is a CYP2D6-inhibition-liability flag ONLY -- it cannot infer a patient's own CYP2D6 genotype/phenotype (poor/intermediate/extensive/ultrarapid metabolizer status). 'Not an inhibitor' does not mean 'safe for poor metabolizers.' See docs/psychiatric-pipeline/scientific-foundation.md.

dataset.source: ChEMBL REST API (direct), CHEMBL289 IC50/nM activities, complete population not a sample (7,587 raw records)
dataset.note: docs/phase9/endpoint-selection.md originally rejected CYP2D6 on sample size using the WRONG ChEMBL target (CHEMBL2035, actually the muscarinic M5 receptor) -- see that document's erratum and docs/psychiatric-pipeline/data-sources.md's CYP2D6 section.

features.note: feature_set_id is IDENTICAL to hERG/CYP3A4/DRD2/HRH1's -- a content address over the shared descriptor/fingerprint/standardisation/RDKit-version toolchain (ADR-005), not a per-dataset identifier.

external_validation.reason: No independent second-source CYP2D6 dataset identified in this pass.

artifact.note: gitignored binary, not committed, same convention as hERG/CYP3A4's artifacts.
artifact.reproducibility: regenerate via: fetch_chembl_data.py -> build_dataset.py -> prepare_features.py -> train.py, in order, RANDOM_SEED=42 fixed throughout.

inference_support._comment: Frozen conformal calibration + AD reference data exported by models/psychiatric/cyp2d6_activity/10_export_inference_support.py -- never recomputed at inference time.

deployment_status.note: Not referenced by deployment/docker/Dockerfile.predict-api or render.yaml's MODEL_RELEASE_URL_BASE assets -- the live drugsim-predict-api service does not serve this model_id yet. Loadable today only from a local checkout with the local artifact files present (e.g. for the psychiatric-pipeline's offline multi-objective screening script).
